'''1st Regiment''' was an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] formation based in the city of [[Tiems]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. 1st Regiment fought in the [[Battle of Tiems]], attacking [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] troops dug in along the [[Blue River]].

==Behind the scenes==
It is unknown if 1st Regiment was the official name of the unit, or whether it was simply an identifier used by the Alliance for debriefing purposes.
